title: Khans of Tarkir Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Khan of the Jeskai, who speaks on enlightenment.

entities.name: Jeskai Way
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir with many martial styles, led by Narset.

entities.name: Mardu Horde
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir that sees death as merely another foe to overcome, led by Zurgo.

entities.name: Golran
entities.description: A dragonscale captain who takes pride in his scales.

entities.name: Qal Sisma mountains
entities.description: Mountains whose high caves young hunters visit to hear the echoes of their ancestors.

entities.name: Anafenza, the Foremost
entities.description: Leader of the Abzan Houses who sits on the Amber Throne and always leads them to battle.

entities.name: Amber Throne
entities.description: The throne of the Abzan leader.

entities.name: Abzan Houses
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir made of Houses, who dread being alone.

entities.name: Surrak Dragonclaw
entities.description: Khan of the Temur, who earned his rank and scars in single combat against a cave bear.

entities.name: Temur Frontier
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir led by Surrak.

entities.name: Riverwalk
entities.description: A Jeskai fighting style that imitates flowing water.

entities.name: Dragonfist
entities.description: A Jeskai fighting style that imitates the ancient hellkites.

entities.name: Flying Crane
entities.description: A Jeskai fighting style that imitates the wild aven of the high peaks.

entities.name: Arel the Whisperer
entities.description: A speaker on the spirit's need for sustenance.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: Khan of the Mardu, who scorns an opponent as no challenge.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of the clans, over which something once soared before being reduced to a throne.

entities.name: Dragon Throne of Tarkir
entities.description: A seat made from what once soared high above Tarkir.

events.summary: Surrak earned his rank and scars in single combat against a cave bear.
events.quote: Both his rank and his scars were earned in single combat against a cave bear.

relations.quote: Anafenza always leads the Abzan Houses to battle.
Rarely at rest on the Amber Throne
